runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 10:27 sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No promotion-grade unique LIVE item was added. ESET Customer Support Specialist is BA-local and entry-level but asks for ideally B2 English. Kariera/UPSVR surfaced several BA driver/admin roles, but the useful-looking ones were weakened by foreign-language requirements, C/C+E, international routes, low pay or other mismatch. Upwork produced fresh Worldwide WordPress/VA hits, but visible candidates were low-budget, development-heavy, strong-English/calling, country-restricted, or trust-risky. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 verifiable hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Remote budget + client-trust triangle
developmentChanges.reason: For freelance remote candidates, combine effective budget, client account age/spend/hire history and scope clarity into one promotion gate. This prevents suspicious high fixed-price beginner listings and uneconomic micro-budgets from entering LIVE while preserving credible remote work.

developmentChanges.title: Driver route-burden classifier
developmentChanges.reason: Classify driver roles into local fixed-route, city/regional, nationwide and international/overnight before ranking. This saves review time and automatically penalizes roles that technically start in Bratislava but conflict with the preferred same-day-home, no-tachograph work pattern.
